target.statement: ICELUT achieves 25.27 dB PSNR on the MIT-Adobe FiveK dataset (expert C), as reported in Table 4.

compute.basis: Training a tiny pointwise CNN for 400 epochs on 4500 480p images is feasible on CPU but slow; GPU would speed up significantly. Data download and preprocessing add time.

title: Taming Lookup Tables for Efficient Image Retouching
